Steps:
1. Check CI status: gh pr checks 856
2. IF CI is green:
   a. Check mergeable: gh pr view 856 --json mergeable
   b. If CONFLICTING → follow the merge conflict protocol
   c. If MERGEABLE → merge: gh pr merge 856 --squash --delete-branch
      Verify merge persisted: gh pr view 856 --json mergedAt --jq '.mergedAt'
      If null after retry → report BLOCKED
   d. Clean up: git worktree remove ../worktrees/issue-839-reaper-counter
3. IF CI is failing:
   a. Get failing run: gh run list --branch fix/issue-839-reaper-counter --limit 1
   b. Get logs: gh run view <RUN_ID> --log
   c. Apply minimal fix in the worktree
   d. Commit and push: git add -A && git commit -m "fix: resolve CI failure" && git push
   e. Wait for CI (poll every 30s, max 10 iterations)
   f. If still failing → report blocker and STOP
4. IF merge conflict:
   a. git fetch origin develop && git rebase origin/develop
   b. Auto-resolve where possible; if unresolvable → STOP and report
   c. git push --force-with-lease origin fix/issue-839-reaper-counter
   d. Re-trigger CI

Report back: final status (MERGED / BLOCKED / CONFLICT), iterations used.
